scope: Theorem 1.3 (All factor endpoints) of the manuscript “The arithmetic category and stable recovery of lattice factors” (preprints/The-arithmetic-category-and-stable-recovery-of-lattice-factors-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 286 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5a2107e608fdff7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Γ ∈ K , let µ be any normalized scalar cocycle on Γ, and let P be a II1 factor with separable predual. There is a nonzero bifinite Lµ(Γ)–P correspondence if and only if P ∼ = Lω(Λ)t for a countably infinite ICC group Λ, a normalized scalar cocycle ω on Λ, and t > 0, for which there are finite-index subgroups A ≤ Γ and B ≤ Λ, an actual isomorphism δ : A → B, and a nonzero finite-dimensional projective unitary representation of A with multiplier µ|A×A δ∗(ω|B×B) . In particular, the reconstructed group Λ belongs to K .
